Jumped Ok sat 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After being crossed near the 1400m commenced to race keenly and continued to race keenly through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, plodded home # no run on

jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced well back Four Wide No Cover (7L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & improving Five Wide @ 500m. Held together 8W (5L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground 9W ini straight. # Wide & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide and without cover in the early stages and near the 1000m was taken wider

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. well back turn. weakened # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced throughout the early and middle stages of the event once the tempo of the race had slackened. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . bit Tight down Straight first time. Settled Down 3rd the fence 2 Lengths @ 1500m. Under Pressure back to 4th 600m and gave Ground To The Turn . dropped right out in Straight . (vetted - no abnormalities) # weak to finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered near the 200m when momentarily crowded. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event and refused to settle. a post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Stewards will follow up on post-race condition

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, ridden along turn, joined in Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m and faded to the line # breeze faded
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. looking for run turn 3 lengths. battled away when clear # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages. When questioned, rider stated that he was instructed to be in a forward position, after beginning fairly he felt that as there were runners to his outside showing initial speed, he elected to obtain cover as he felt he would be racing tight between runners when approaching the 1300m turn. Was held up for clear running rounding the home turn and was unable to improve until passing the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 1 length Two Wide turning, hit Lead 175m, Headed 60m from post # battled on ok
( Blinkers 1st Time ) Jumped Well , Drifted Back Settled Down Clear last, 8 Lengths @ 1100m. Ridden Along Two Wide chasing in Clear . Just No Match for $1.35 winner, gap to 3rd # solid in defeat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early  stages

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Restrained to race 5th on inside (4L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & struggling to hold ground 3 Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & gave ground in straight. Vetted clear. # Struggled from turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.
